intent: Represents one other node in the cluster as seen from this node: its connection socket, replication state, and the synchronization/standup metadata SQLiteNode needs to run consensus.

objects.name: SQLitePeer
objects.role: one peer's connection + replication/consensus state, guarded by an internal mutex

objects.name: SQLitePeer::Response
objects.role: a peer's vote on a standup request (NONE/APPROVE/DENY)

objects.name: SQLitePeer::PeerPostPollStatus
objects.role: result of postPoll: OK, just-connected, socket error, or socket closed
